title: BPW-2026-0624
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0624
The Mayor has approved and authorized the Board of Public Works, on behalf of the Bureau of Engineering, to execute the request for Letter of Agreement for the Madrid Theatre Renovation Phase 2 Project.
(REF: BPW-2026-0584)
summary: Mayor-approved authority for the Bureau of Engineering to sign a Letter of Agreement for phase two of the Madrid Theatre renovation.
